banner.title: THE DSG WHAT-IS-IT FRONT MATTER - the printed p. 6 chapter frame opening the book: the mystery of the underdark, the new rules for underground play, the denizens of the underdark, the underground campaign and the using-this-information player/DM split - the parent and all five children closed in one round.
banner.provenance: from the DSG chapter on printed p. 6, djvu lines 466-585, between the credits and the Overview of the Underdark (the R503 extraction round); every promise cross-checked against the chapter that later lands it - the climbing and proficiencies the movement chapter, the cultures the R532 round, the generators the R533 Deepearth frame, the 3-D mapping the R557 doctrine.

consts.name: dcqFramePage
consts.comment: the chapter sits on printed p. 6 between the credits and the Overview of the Underdark - the front-matter frame opening the whole book.

consts.name: dcqNamedCultureCount
consts.comment: the denizens subhead names four cultures - the drow, duergar, kuo-toa and myconids revealed in their natural environments - the cultures the R532 chapter later lands in full.

consts.name: dcqSectionCount
consts.comment: the book splits into two sections: the first for player and DM alike (the expanded rules, the spells, the proficiencies, the new equipment), the latter tailored to the DM alone.

consts.name: dcqPlayerLureCount
consts.comment: the mystery subhead counts three subterranean lures beneath the earth - the most fearsome foes, the most fabulous treasures and the most mysterious locales.

bools.name: dcqNonthiefClimbCovered
bools.comment: the new-rules subhead asks whether a non-thief can climb a rough stone wall, fight while clinging to the wall, or duel atop a swaying footbridge - all covered by the rules this book introduces (the movement chapter era).

bools.name: dcqProficienciesFromOA
bools.comment: the proficiencies were first introduced in the AD&D Oriental Adventures book; the DSG reintroduces them and adds many more suited to the underearth.

bools.name: dcqRandomGenerators
bools.comment: the denizens subhead promises the detailed random location and encounter generators - exciting adventuring with little or no preparation time (the Deepearth R533 generators).

bools.name: dcqForbiddenDMHalf
bools.comment: the using-this-information subhead marks the latter portion the DM's Forbidden Territory - players should avoid it or face the wrath of the DM.
